_description: Available MCP servers that users can enable per-workspace. Copy the desired server block into your workspace .mcp.json and fill in the required env vars.

google-drive.description: Read/write Google Drive files and folders (Docs, Sheets, upload, download, search). Enables workspace-to-Drive sync as an Obsidian vault.

env.GOOGLE_DRIVE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS: (required) Path to gcp-oauth.keys.json (OAuth 2.0 Desktop app credentials from Google Cloud Console)

setup: 1. Go to https://console.cloud.google.com/ → create a project
2. Enable: Drive API, Docs API, Sheets API, Slides API
3. Create OAuth 2.0 credentials → type 'Desktop app' → download JSON → save as gcp-oauth.keys.json
4. Run once to authorize: npx @piotr-agier/google-drive-mcp auth --credentials /path/to/gcp-oauth.keys.json
5. Add this server to your workspace .mcp.json with GOOGLE_DRIVE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS pointing to that file
